# Overlay panels

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Material Design 3, appearance, and layout · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

styles.css `.palette { resize: both }`, menu.ts viewport clamping, dockview floating groups

## What is missing

edge/corner resize and header drag for notification centre, menus, picker, takeovers; keyboard resize/move; per-surface persisted size and position with reset (palette only)
